limitations: Numeric limits were fixed by operator under existing authorization; no new PO numeric-budget declaration was invented.
Single round against mixed-attempt history cannot establish causal gain, stability, cold/warm latency, cost or production performance.
Requested model alias is known; observed immutable model/sampler/cost and hardware resource telemetry are unknown.
Fresh PO judged extra identity questions nonmaterial in two blocked cases; uncertainty failures persist, with no historical approvals transferred.
No model promotion, paid API service, fallback, training or story completion.
summary: Executed one frozen v3.3 development round: 16 serial calls, eight valid generations/audits, no retries/repair/holdout. Initial assessments stayed not-run with zero migrated reviews. Subsequent fresh PO judgments in DOC-0036: six pass, two uncertainty fail, zero pending. Default unchanged and candidate not promoted.
title: Rodada corretiva v3.3 com orçamento fixado e revisão independente por snapshot
